title: MediaTek hires former TSMC executive to boost AI chip packaging
title_zh: 联发科聘请台积电前高管，推动AI芯片封装
summary: Taiwanese chip designer MediaTek said it has appointed former ‌TSMC executive Douglas Yu as a part-time ‌adviser as it steps up advanced packaging work and expands ​into the AI chip market.
summary_zh: 台湾芯片设计商联发科表示，已任命前台积电高管 Douglas Yu 为兼职顾问，以加强先进封装工作并进军人工智能芯片市场。

title: GameStop makes bold $56 billion play for eBay, ready to go hostile
title_zh: GameStop 斥资 560 亿美元大胆收购 eBay，准备发起敌对行动
summary: GameStop proposed on Sunday to buy eBay Inc for about $56 billion in a cash-and-stock deal, with CEO Ryan Cohen saying he was prepared to take the bid directly to shareholders should eBay's board be unreceptive.
summary_zh: GameStop 周日提议以约 560 亿美元的现金和股票交易收购 eBay 公司，首席执行官瑞安·科恩 (Ryan Cohen) 表示，如果 eBay 董事会不接受，他准备直接向股东提出收购要约。

title: Traders Grapple With Two-Sided Tail Risk as Stocks Regain Highs
title_zh: 随着股市重回高位，交易员努力应对两侧尾部风险
summary: (Bloomberg) -- With equities back to their highs after a V-shaped recovery from the Iran oil shock, investors are increasingly caught between left and right tail risks: The tireless AI and semiconductor rally on one side and the gradual drag from higher energy prices on the ot...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——随着股市从伊朗石油危机中出现 V 型复苏后回到高位，投资者越来越多地陷入左尾风险和右尾风险之间：一方面是人工智能和半导体的不懈上涨，另一方面是能源价格上涨的逐渐拖累……

title: 'It's a boom': Wall Street sees more market gains as strong earnings fuel the AI trade
title_zh: “这是一次繁荣”：随着强劲的盈利推动人工智能贸易，华尔街看到了更多的市场收益
summary: Stocks sit near all-time highs as earnings growth has fueled the best month for the S&P 500 since November 2020.
summary_zh: 由于盈利增长推动标普 500 指数创下自 2020 年 11 月以来表现最好的月份，股市接近历史高点。

title: Big Tech Earnings Show Split Between AI Trade Winners and Losers
title_zh: 大型科技公司的盈利显示人工智能贸易的赢家和输家之间存在分歧
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The world’s biggest technology companies posted strong earnings last week, showing that the artificial intelligence boom is alive and well.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——全球最大的科技公司上周发布了强劲的盈利报告，表明人工智能热潮依然存在。

title: 5 things we learned during S&P 500 earnings madness
title_zh: 我们在标准普尔 500 指数盈利疯狂期间学到的 5 件事
summary: So many lessons from earnings season, so little time
summary_zh: 财报季的教训太多，时间却太少

title: Jobs day, semiconductor earnings, and stock market momentum: What to watch this week
title_zh: 就业日、半导体收益和股市势头：本周值得关注的内容
summary: The April jobs report, earnings reports from major semiconductor companies, and a strong start to the month for US equities outline a busy week for investors.
summary_zh: 四月份的就业报告、主要半导体公司的盈利报告以及美国股市本月的强劲开局，为投资者描绘了忙碌的一周。
